```{r, include = FALSE}
source(here::here("setup.R"))
for (file in list.files(here::here("R"), full.names = TRUE)) source(file)
df <- readRDS(file.path(output_dir, "df.rds"))
```


# Model fitting

Training models on the processed training data.

```{r}
df_small <- df |> slice(1:500)
fitted_models <- fit_all(df_small)
fitted_models$results
```

Finding the best model (based on accuracy).

```{r}
best_model <- fitted_models$models[[which.max(fitted_models$results$accuracy)]]
best_model_name <- names(fitted_models$models)[[which.max(fitted_models$results$accuracy)]]
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\n")
```

## Visualizing results

Visualizing results of different models to see how the "best" model compares to the rest.

```{r}
ggplot(fitted_models$results, aes(x = accuracy, y = kappa)) +
  geom_point(data = fitted_models$results[best_model_name, ], size = 5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = rownames(fitted_models$results)))
```

```{r}
rs <- resamples(fitted_models$models)
bwplot(rs, col = ifelse(rs$models == best_model_name, "red", "black"))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
saveRDS(best_model, file.path(output_dir, "best_model.rds"))
```
